name: Leeks
source:
Leeks – is a character in Heralds of the Avirentes - Ch. 1 Wings of Change.
A silver-toned om'verai with a smooth, streamlined form and polished scales. His horns curve with precision, alternating between ivory white and deep indigo, while sharp, wing-like fins frame. Piercing green eyes, glowing like emerald flame. Jagged spines crown his head and neck.
Leeks likes spending time with children, enjoys hitchhiking and exploring crystal caves. Leeks's both a job and a hobby is to grow plants, including fruits and vegetables. Despite of being a matured om'verai, Leeks seems to not understand women's feelings, which may be a reason behind him still remaining unmarried. Leeks seems to be reliable when it comes to covering up his niece, Azaries. Not much familar with modern pop-culture. Both Leeks and Cirrus like making compliments towards female relatives or friends.
